scope: Generic full-scale negative thrust and torque coefficients for windmilling, braked and locked fixed-pitch propeller operation. Not McCauley, C172P or C172S propeller data.

source.title: The Negative Thrust and Torque of Several Full-Scale Propellers and Their Application to Various Flight Problems
source.download_note: The served file has a 436-byte NTRS prefix before the PDF header; the PDF starting at byte offset 436 has SHA-256 3a67650a5fc5fff31343c64b424eb3e06a6a9085347b55f6e8017c3e95742527 and 24 pages.

source.figure: Figure 3, printed page 3 (PDF page 7): negative thrust and torque coefficients for propeller 5868-9, Clark Y section, 2 blades
source.test_article: 10-foot diameter metal Navy propeller 5868-9, Clark Y sections, 2 blades, ahead of a radial-engine nacelle in the NACA 20-foot tunnel at 100-110 mph; cross-faired curves

definitions.advance: nD/V, propeller revolutions per second times diameter divided by airspeed; 0 is the locked propeller
definitions.Tc: Te / (rho V^2 D^2), where Te = T - delta D is effective thrust (shaft axial force minus the slipstream-induced drag change of the test radial-engine nacelle); negative is drag. Applying Tc as JSBSim shaft thrust therefore includes that installation-specific nacelle effect.
definitions.Qc: Q / (rho V^2 D^3), aerodynamic torque; negative assists rotation

digitization.method: The PDF page was rendered at 5x with macOS PDFKit. Grid lines were located from dark-pixel column/row profiles; curve centres were traced with dark-run column scans and checked against the printed curve labels, zero crossings and visual crops. Readings are linear in the local grid between calibrated lines.
digitization.uncertainty: About +/-0.0003 in Tc and +/-0.00004 in Qc (1-2 rendered pixels on a 0.005 Tc / 0.0005 Qc minor grid), larger where curves cross; nD/V about +/-0.003. Cross-fairing by the original authors is retained, not removed.
digitization.zero_crossing_note: The final row of each list is the read zero crossing of that curve, where the chart's negative region ends.
